conditions: In force since 2026-08-09 (Final Administrative Order OTC000039). GRASE up to 6% for adults and children 6 months of age and older; finished product SPF >= 2. Permitted dosage forms: oil, lotion, cream, gel, butter, paste, ointment, stick; spray only with no propellant (pump) or with the propellant isolated from the formulation (bag-on-valve). Not permitted: propellant-combined aerosol sprays, powders. Not GRASE in combination with aminobenzoic acid or trolamine salicylate. 18-month marketing exclusivity for DSM Nutritional Products LLC from the effective date.
source: FDA Final Administrative Order OTC000039 (issued 2026-06-10, corrected 2026-08-10)
